note: PAPER ONLY. Squad 5 baskets (SQ5-*: index-style rules). newSignals = the CURRENT members of each basket (what the rule holds after its latest review), not a new-signal list; a basket is meant to be owned as a whole. Nothing here is a buy by itself: a rule needs a frozen 5-year verdict that qualifies (data/squad5-lab.json firstRun). Halal = the owner's ZAD mark; "unknown" must be checked before any real buy. Entries and exits from 2026-10-26 are recorded in data/squad5-paper.jsonl.
